title: Rebel 1100 DCT
description: The Honda Rebel 1100 DCT is combines low-slung road presence with generous low-end torque rumble, positioned in the Performance Cruiser segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 1100cc engine generating 150 HP and 120 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 230 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Upright Neutral riding stance and an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
